sample_unit: anonymized prehospital EMS patient care records

links.outcome: Inter-rater reliability between two expert human reviewers establishing the reference standard
links.effect: Human reviewers showed high interrater reliability, with 91.2% agreement and a kappa coefficient 0.782 (0.654-0.910).
links.quote: Human reviewers showed high interrater reliability, with 91.2% agreement and a kappa coefficient 0.782 (0.654-0.910).

links.outcome: LLM agreement with expert human reviewers on EMS quality assurance metrics on the same records
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 had 76.2% agreement (kappa 0.401) with human reviewers on EKG documentation and aspirin administration, varying across other metrics. Gemini Ultra was discontinued due to poor performance.
links.quote: Gemini Ultra's evaluation was discontinued due to poor performance.

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of ChatGPT-4 and Gemini Ultra for reviewing prehospital EMS patient care reports for quality assurance against human reviewers, but does not evaluate a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
